longs.thesis: FDA granted accelerated approval for Voceryq (INO-3107), the first plasmid DNA-based immunotherapy approved in the U.S., for recurrent respiratory papillomatosis; +~167-240% premarket on huge volume.
Affle agreed to acquire Perion for $11.70/share in cash (~$420M), a 34.5% premium to Friday's $8.70 close; gapping toward the deal price, which caps upside.
S&P Dow Jones announced Okta joins the S&P 500 before the open Wed Nov 4, replacing Kenvue; rebounding after a -6.1% Friday drop to $208.24.
Report that SpaceX is in talks to buy Boost Mobile or gain access to its network for a Starlink Mobile wireless service; no deal confirmed, no price reported.
After-hours bounce / unusual volume with no fresh company announcement found; high-risk momentum name only, with conflicting premarket snapshots.

shorts.thesis: Q3 beat but Q4 guide badly missed ($15-16B revenue, $0.25 EPS vs ~$17.1B / ~$0.43 expected); -28.6% Friday to $65.76 on record volume, Bank of America downgrade.
Q3 missed on both lines (EPS $0.06 vs ~$0.13, revenue ~$410M vs ~$466M, net loss $43M); Q4 production guided below Q3, compounded by crude falling ~4%.
SpaceX/EchoStar Boost Mobile talks threaten a new satellite-powered wireless competitor; telecom incumbents down ~1-2.3% premarket on the headline.
